intro: Proposals only — nothing here changes the plan automatically. Review, pick a path, and the next build implements it.

paths.name: Star-first, everything walkable
paths.pick: Stay at The Venetian Resort (4 MICHELIN distinctions on campus) or MGM Grand (both Robuchon rooms).
paths.pros: No transit needed for four MICHELIN rooms; suites are 650 sq ft+ with private oversized bathrooms; the Venetian is the densest cluster in the city.
paths.cons: Highest cost. No dated Venetian rate was retrievable, so the budget is unknown; a prior session logged $6,170.43 all-in for 7 nights.
paths.bestIf: The restaurants are the reason for the trip and the budget is flexible.

paths.name: Value-first on the Strip
paths.pick: Flamingo Las Vegas, Flamingo Room | 2 Queens — $581 for 7 nights before tax, center Strip.
paths.pros: Cheapest verified two-queen total found; center-Strip walk to Caesars Palace (Guy Savoy), Bellagio (Michael Mina) and the LINQ (High Roller); Monorail and Deuce on the doorstep.
paths.cons: No MICHELIN restaurant inside the resort; 350 sq ft rooms are the smallest verified in this set; two seasonal pools and a casino-floor location mean noise.
paths.bestIf: You want the 1–2 week stay and a restaurant list rather than a resort.

paths.name: Space and quiet, south of the noise
paths.pick: South Point, Premium 2 Queens — $989 for 7 nights including fees, 500 sq ft.
paths.pros: Best documented pricing across three date windows; largest verified non-suite room (500 sq ft); free valet parking; airport shuttle; 2,079 rooms.
paths.cons: Well south of the center Strip; public-transit door-to-door time unverified; no MICHELIN restaurant nearby.
paths.bestIf: You will rent a car, value space, and treat the Strip as a day trip.
unknowns: resort-fee discrepancy ($29.20 engine vs $33 public page)

siteImprovements.title: Add an all-in cost calculator (tax + resort fee + food + activities)
siteImprovements.why: Every total on the site is pre-tax; the real bill is materially higher. This is the single biggest decision-quality gap.
siteImprovements.needs: Applicable room-tax rate from an official Nevada/Clark County source or a captured checkout tax line.

siteImprovements.title: Capture dated prices for MGM Resorts, Venetian, Wynn, Resorts World and Fontainebleau
siteImprovements.why: Seven of eleven hotels have no verified rate, so the ranking is dominated by cheap Caesars properties.
siteImprovements.needs: A browser-capable fetch (the MGM/Venetian engines render client-side) or manual screenshots with dates.

siteImprovements.title: Replace blank restaurant hours with a single verified hours table
siteImprovements.why: 17 of 24 rows have no hours, which blocks day-by-day planning.
siteImprovements.needs: One fetch per venue restaurant page; record the capture date.

siteImprovements.title: Add exact two-person menu totals for starred rooms
siteImprovements.why: Only Partage publishes a total. Starred menus are the largest single expense line after the room.
siteImprovements.needs: Menu PDFs or a phone/email price request; do not estimate.

siteImprovements.title: Build a real door-to-door transit matrix from the RTC Trip Planner
siteImprovements.why: The 1-hour rule cannot currently be verified for any venue pair.
siteImprovements.needs: RTC trip-planner queries for the exact hotel→venue pairs on a weekday and a weekend day.

siteImprovements.title: Add a printable one-page itinerary for the 3-night and 7-night versions
siteImprovements.why: Tables are good for decisions, bad for the street.
siteImprovements.needs: Nothing new; use confirmed hours only.

siteImprovements.title: Add verified social/creator links per venue
siteImprovements.why: The brief asks for YouTube/TikTok/Instagram links; only the Neon Museum and Caesars Palace accounts are verifiable from official sites today.
siteImprovements.needs: Venue websites that link their accounts, or platform verification of each handle.

siteImprovements.title: Add a price-watch log (date, hotel, room, total) so 'best time to book' becomes measurable
siteImprovements.why: A single snapshot cannot establish the cheapest booking date. A weekly log can.
siteImprovements.needs: Repeat the same dated URL each week and append the result.

siteImprovements.title: Fold the six parallel session sites into an archive page
siteImprovements.why: The repository now publishes seven competing sites, which confuses which one is authoritative.
siteImprovements.needs: Agreement that this consolidated site is canonical (implemented in this session; old pages preserved).

siteImprovements.title: Add accessibility and mobility notes per hotel
siteImprovements.why: Room sizes and bathroom layouts are captured, mobility distances are not.

siteImprovements.title: Add a Feb 2027 event calendar (conventions, shows, F1 works)
siteImprovements.why: Events drive room prices and traffic. RTC already publishes F1-related service changes.
siteImprovements.needs: LVCVA convention calendar and venue calendars.

siteImprovements.title: Publish an explicit 'what we could not verify' count on the landing page
siteImprovements.why: Sets expectations and stops blanks being read as zero.
siteImprovements.needs: Nothing; implemented from the flag list.

siteImprovements.title: Reconcile the 24-restaurant list membership (Gimme Sum Dim Sum vs Ping Pang Pong)
siteImprovements.why: A parallel session (c88d116c) verified hours for Gimme Sum Dim Sum (Wed–Mon 9 AM–9 PM, Tue closed), which is not among the canonical 24; the off-Strip Chinese slot is held by Ping Pang Pong (Gold Coast). One of the two lists disagrees with the official 2026 MICHELIN selection.
siteImprovements.needs: Side-by-side check of the official 2026 MICHELIN Las Vegas selection against the canonical 24 names; add or swap the row if the guide lists Gimme Sum Dim Sum.

siteImprovements.title: Put the verified booking deadline at the top of the landing page
siteImprovements.why: The most valuable fact found is time-limited: Wynn's $677 Cyber rate must be booked by December 4, 2026, and it saves $1,092 over 7 nights versus the Flexible rate. Burying it below eleven hotel rows risks the reader missing it entirely.
siteImprovements.needs: Nothing further — IMPLEMENTED in this pass as a dated banner driven by booking.bookTiming.deadlines.

siteImprovements.title: Show a per-night date strip instead of only a single stay average
siteImprovements.why: Resorts World's official February calendar reveals a 16% swing between adjacent 7-night windows ($1,942 for Feb 15–22 vs $1,632 for Feb 18–25). A single average hides that.
siteImprovements.needs: Nothing further — IMPLEMENTED in this pass on Prices & dates. Fee basis still unresolved (F-26).

siteImprovements.title: Cite the primary MICHELIN press release, not only the tourism-board page
siteImprovements.why: MGM's own site shows a star badge Bardot Brasserie does not hold (F-24) and review blogs invent stars for Mizumi and Sage. A first-party primary source with street addresses settles tier disputes and proves Monte is in Utah, not Las Vegas.
siteImprovements.needs: Nothing further — IMPLEMENTED in this pass; the press release is now recorded as guide.primarySource.

siteImprovements.title: Add a 'closed on your dates' filter driven by the verified calendars
siteImprovements.why: Three verified facts silently break itineraries: Bellagio Conservatory is dark Mar 7–12; Joël Robuchon is closed Mon/Sun while L'Atelier is closed Tue/Wed; Red Rock needs a timed reservation on every day of the window.
siteImprovements.needs: A chosen check-in date from the reader, plus verified daily hours for the remaining restaurants.

siteImprovements.title: Stamp a capture timestamp on every dynamic price cell
siteImprovements.why: Caesars Palace moved from $226 to $214 per night in one day (F-23). Without a per-cell timestamp a reader cannot tell a stale figure from a fresh one.
siteImprovements.needs: A re-verification run that writes capture dates per cell rather than one page-level date.

siteImprovements.title: Reconcile GitHub Pages source with the Pages workflow
siteImprovements.why: Pages serves the repository ROOT (legacy source main '/'), but pages.yml uploads the docs/ folder. Prior-session notes therefore point at wrong URLs, which wastes review time (R-15).
siteImprovements.needs: Owner decision: switch Pages to GitHub Actions, or retire the misleading workflow. Shared infrastructure — not changed in this pass.
